poc_summary: 2-week Dedicated staging POC (vpc) - baseline 2 GPU equiv. -> showed 2.3x unit cost improvement vs Hosted after batching + prefix caching. Latency p50 110-140ms; peak throughput ~420 req/min. Team validated call-level tracing and per-route cost breakdown.
pricing_summary: Current commercial proposal (verbal): three commit tiers: 1) Starter - 2 GPU equiv reserved ($18k/mo), 2) Growth - 4 GPU equiv reserved ($34k/mo), 3) Scale - 8 GPU equiv reserved ($62k/mo). Burst allowed up to 2x baseline at +40% premium (billed hourly), overage beyond burst billed per-token at $0.09 per 1k tokens. 12-month commit preferred by customer with 3-month ramp (50% usage months 1-3, full commit month 4). Finance asked for cap on monthly overage and option to pre-purchase burst credits.
negotiation_notes: Customer pushing for: lower burst premium (proposal: +25% vs our +40%), transparent overage cap ($8k/mo), and amortized billing over 12 months. Redwood pricing team proposed staged discount if commit increases at Q4 review. Legal wants SLA language for automatic fallback to Hosted API in cross-region outage.
